checklistApplied: No text, logos, trademarks, or watermarks
Opaque backgrounds are 16:9 and leave negative space for characters and captions
Character atlases use genuine transparency, generous padding, full-body views, visible hands, feet, and faces, and four columns for pose swaps

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 animation background plate for a deterministic frame-by-frame comedy.
